items.title: 68090_Ed Garland oral history interview
items.q: INTERVIEWER: When did -- with what band did you play with Sidney Catlett? INTERVIEWEE: Well we played with Louie.

ctx.x: Well Minor Hall was pretty good. Cozy Cole, was pretty good. We had so many -- lot of pretty good cymbal players, you know?
Sid -- oh my goodness, yeah he was -- he was wonderful.

items.title: 68090_Ed Garland oral history interview
items.q: INTERVIEWER: ...we mentioned Sid Catlett and your face lit up... INTERVIEWEE: Oh, yeah. He never overpowered the band, you know.

ctx.x: Enjoyed that cymbal, he could take that cymbal and come down there, you know, so nice and soft.

Uh-huh. Yeah, you -- you, last time we met we were talking -- we mentioned Sid Catlett and your face lit up, just like it did this time. I've always enjoyed his playing too. And all the drummers loved his playing, so that means he was doing something right.
